profile.description: Al Batinah Power Company SAOG designs, develops, finances, constructs, operates, maintains, insures, and owns a power generating facility, associated gas interconnection facilities, and other infrastructure facilities in the Sultanate of Oman. It owns the Sohar 2 power plant with a power capacity of approximately 750 MW located in the Al Batinah region of the Sultanate of Oman. Al Batinah Power Company SAOG was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Al Khuwayrah, Oman.
